currentState: Close old colleagues separated by her southern errand. Lor'themar is carrying the Convocation in her place; in Ch3 she writes him the Millhaven dispatch and sends it by Neral to be put 'in Lor'themar's hand yourself'.
powerDynamic: Equals; she trusts him to carry hard news to a chamber that likes him better than her.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Lifts two fingers off the reins as a farewell; he raises an arm and turns his horse.

nameUsage.sylvanasCallsLorthemar: 'Lor'themar' bare; first word of the dispatch.

history.event: Long shared patrols; he takes her place at the Convocation budget session; she asks him to send word once she knows what the prisoner is.
Chapter 3 (by letter, one-sided): she writes Thalassian, no greeting, ending 'I am going on south.' She imagines him reading it to the Convocation in his pleasant voice and being liked for it.

trajectory: He will receive a hard-evidence border warning; his reaction is off the page until the next chapter that includes him.
